hooks.command: branch=$(git branch --show-current); commit=$(git log -1 --format="%h %ad %s" --date=short 2>/dev/null); jq -n --arg b "$branch" --arg c "$commit" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Current branch: " + $b + " | Last commit: " + $c + ". Run /start-session for full orientation.")}}'

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *"/src/frontend/"*.jsx) [ -x src/frontend/node_modules/.bin/eslint ] && src/frontend/node_modules/.bin/eslint --config src/frontend/eslint.config.js "$f" ;; esac; } 2>&1 || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *"/src/"*.cs) dotnet build src/ChefAgent.sln --no-restore ;; esac; } 2>&1 || true

if git status --porcelain -- 'src/*.cs' 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then out=$(dotnet build src/ChefAgent.sln --no-restore --configuration Debug 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg o "$out" '{systemMessage: ("⚠ dotnet build failed — do not consider backend work done until this is green:\n" + ($o | .[0:800]))}'; fi; fi
